formal_statement: Coordinate contraction preserves counterexample status for the quotient witness.
assumptions: accepted equivalent coordinates; quotient witness defined; status fields congruent
reason: Too strong without an equivalent-coordinate counterexample-status congruence theorem.

formal_statement: If status is not literally preserved, the contracted object is a smaller counterexample witness.
assumptions: nontrivial class exists; contracted status remains valid counterexample or reduced obstruction
reason: Measure decrease is available, but valid reduced-status transfer remains open.

formal_statement: Coordinate contraction preserves status or reduces to a smaller counterexample witness.
assumptions: quotient congruence; nontrivial class; support measure guard
reason: This is useful but still too strong before counterexample-status congruence closes.

formal_statement: Coordinate contraction preserves status, reduces to a smaller witness, or routes failure to a named blocker/deferred higher-support escape.
assumptions: equivalent coordinate notation; contraction semantics; status language; measure guard; escape interface
reason: Selected because it formalizes the status branch without hiding the open congruence theorem.

formal_statement: Every support-growth witness has full coordinate-contraction status congruence.
assumptions: arbitrary support-growth witness; complete quotient/status congruence; all preservation proofs
reason: Out of scope; would incorrectly promote one operation status proof to a full theorem.
